items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: The composer was Vince Guaraldi, the great jazz pianist from San Francisco who wrote the score to the Peanuts stuff on TV.

ctx.x: nameless thing like some nameless orchestra covering it, and so I always thought that was it.

Well if I may, because I remember this and was alive then. It was way before your time, but whatever it was, ’64 maybe, the hit version was this orchestral thing you’re referring to. A nameless, you know a studio orchestra that they called Sounds Orchestral. That was the hit. To me, you’re right, that was the hit. The composer was Vince Guaraldi, the great jazz pianist from San Francisco who wrote the score to the Peanuts stuff on TV. But he didn’t have a hit on it. His version is interesting, a little more…
